paper.title_en: Deformed nuclei; how to separate the wheat from the chaff
paper.abstract_en: The quadrupole-quadrupole correlations are dominant in all nuclei with neutrons and protons outside magic closures. A subset among these shows features reminiscent of semiclassical rotors, i.e. J(J+1) spectra, and spectroscopic quadrupole moments and transition probabilities B(E2)'s consistent with the Bohr-Mottelson ansatz. But in the great majority of the cases the situation is not so clear. The Kumar-Cline invariants are an invaluable tool to decide to what extent the shape parameters $\beta $ and $\gamma $ are meaningful.
